cases.name: original synchronous playback
cases.source:
import java.io.File
class VoicePlayback { fun play(bytes: ByteArray) { File.createTempFile("play", "audio").writeBytes(bytes) } }

cases.name: import alias
cases.source:
import java.io.File as CacheFile
class VoiceCapture { fun stop() = CacheFile("audio").readBytes() }

cases.name: qualified type alias
cases.source:
typealias Audio = java.io.File
class VoiceCapture { var file: Audio? = null }

cases.name: unrelated same spelling
cases.source:
class Blob { fun readBytes() = byteArrayOf(1) }
class VoiceCapture { fun stop() = Blob().readBytes() }

cases.source:

class VoiceFileWork { fun read(file: File) = file.readBytes() }
